# set dir and load data
```{r}
gitrepo_path = "/Users/momocco/Documents/GitHub/srndna-ug/behavioral_analyses"

data_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"data", sep = "/")
codes_dir = paste(gitrepo_path, "codes", sep = "/")
fit_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"fits", sep = "/")
figure_dir = paste(gitrepo_path,"figures", sep = "/")

L3_template_df = read.csv(paste(data_dir, "L3_template_n47_ultimatum_twogroup_wCovs.csv", sep = "/"), header = TRUE)
```

# find interquantile ranges
## tsnr
```{r}
tsnr_Q1 <- quantile(L3_template_df$tsnr, 0.25)
tsnr_Q3 <- quantile(L3_template_df$tsnr, 0.75)
tsnrIQR = tsnr_Q3 - tsnr_Q1

tsnr_lower_bound <- tsnr_Q1 - 1.5 * tsnrIQR
print(tsnr_lower_bound)
tsnr_upper_bound <- tsnr_Q3 + 1.5 * tsnrIQR
print(tsnr_upper_bound)

L3_template_df = L3_template_df %>% 
  mutate(tsnr_is_outlier = tsnr < tsnr_lower_bound | tsnr_upper_bound > tsnr_upper_bound)
```

## fd_mean
```{r}
fd_mean_Q1 <- quantile(L3_template_df$fd_mean, 0.25)
fd_mean_Q3 <- quantile(L3_template_df$fd_mean, 0.75)
fd_meanIQR = fd_mean_Q3 - fd_mean_Q1

fd_mean_lower_bound <- fd_mean_Q1 - 1.5 * fd_meanIQR
print(fd_mean_lower_bound)
fd_mean_upper_bound <- fd_mean_Q3 + 1.5 * fd_meanIQR
print(fd_mean_upper_bound)

L3_template_df = L3_template_df %>% 
  mutate(fd_is_outlier = fd_mean < fd_mean_lower_bound | fd_mean_upper_bound > fd_mean_upper_bound)
```

```{r}
N_tsnr_outlier = sum(L3_template_df$tsnr_is_outlier)
print(N_tsnr_outlier)

N_fd_outlier = sum(L3_template_df$fd_is_outlier)
print(N_fd_outlier)
```
